title: 同じ給付、違う入口
jp: 制度の名前が全国で同じでも、利用できる量まで同じとは限らない。給付の条件が等しく書かれていても、ある地域には事業所と人手があり、別の地域では週に一度の支援さえ細い入口になる。ここで差を作るのは権利の文言ではなく、定員、距離、働く人の数である。紙の上では同じ一単位でも、生活の側では待ち時間や移動や諦めを含んだ、まったく異なる重さを持つ。
translationLiteral: Even if a system has the same name nationwide, the amount that can actually be used is not necessarily equal. Even when the conditions for benefits are written equally, one region has providers and workers, while in another region even support once a week becomes a narrow entrance. What creates the difference here is not the wording of the right but capacity, distance, and the number of people who work. The same unit on paper carries a completely different weight in daily life, including waiting time, travel, and resignation.
translationNatural: A nationwide benefit does not guarantee nationwide access. Eligibility may be written in equal terms, yet actual support depends on local capacity, distance, and staffing. In one region, services are available; in another, even an occasional visit may be difficult to secure. The unit recorded by the system looks identical on paper, but its weight in daily life changes with the waiting, travel, and compromises required to receive it.
imageCaption: 同じ給付券の先に、広い入口と細い入口が分かれている場面。

translationNote: 「同じ給付、違う入口」という比喩を、natural では benefit と access の対照に置き換えた。「週に一度」は会話の問題意識を一般化して an occasional visit とし、地域差の構造を強調した。
readingPoint: 導入では、給付条件の平等と利用可能性の平等を切り分ける。制度の単位から生活上の待機・移動へ視線を移し、帳簿に表れない費用という主題を準備する。

title: 家族へ移る請求書
jp: 支援が足りないとき、必要な世話まで消えるわけではない。制度が引き受けなかった時間は、家族の予定の中へ移される。仕事を調整し、離れた場所へ通い、足りない回数を埋める。その労力に請求書が付かなければ、行政の支出には現れにくい。しかし、費用が計上されないことと、費用が存在しないことは同じではない。公的な帳簿が軽くなった分だけ、私的な一日が重くなる。
translationLiteral: When support is insufficient, the necessary care does not disappear. The time that the system did not take on is moved into the family's schedule. They adjust work, travel to a distant place, and fill the missing visits. If no invoice is attached to that labor, it is unlikely to appear in public expenditure. However, a cost not being recorded is not the same as a cost not existing. To the extent that the public ledger becomes lighter, the private day becomes heavier.
translationNatural: When formal support falls short, the need for care remains. The missing hours are transferred into family schedules, where they become adjustments to work, repeated travel, and unpaid substitution for services that were unavailable. Because this labor produces no invoice, it is easy to omit from the public account. But an unrecorded cost is still a cost. What disappears from the institutional ledger returns as weight inside an ordinary day.
imageCaption: 公的な帳簿から消えた時間が、家族の一日の予定表へ移される場面。
imagePrompt: Hours lifting off a sparse public ledger and settling heavily onto a family calendar filled with travel and care duties, conceptual editorial illustration, no readable text

readingPoint: 第二章では、地域差が生む不足を家族負担へ接続する。請求書の有無と費用の有無を分け、公的会計の外に出た時間が私生活の重さとして残ることを示す。

title: 理念と配達
jp: 憲法は、健康で文化的な最低限度の生活を権利として掲げ、国に社会福祉と社会保障の向上を求めている。その文言は制度の向きを定めるが、文章だけで近所に事業所が建つわけでも、働く人が配置されるわけでもない。理念を空文にしないためには、予算、定員、交通、人員という配達の仕組みが要る。権利は入口に掲げた看板だけでは届かない。最後の一人まで運ばれて、初めて生活の中で効力を持つ。
translationLiteral: The Constitution presents the right to maintain the minimum standards of wholesome and cultured living and asks the state to improve social welfare and social security. That wording determines the direction of the system, but text alone does not build a provider nearby or assign workers. To keep the principle from becoming empty words, a delivery mechanism of budgets, capacity, transportation, and personnel is needed. A right does not arrive through a sign placed at the entrance alone. Only when it is carried to the last person does it gain force in daily life.
translationNatural: The Constitution recognizes a right to minimum standards of wholesome and cultured living and directs the state to advance social welfare and social security. Such language sets a destination, but it does not by itself create nearby services or staff them. A principle reaches daily life only through delivery systems: budgets, capacity, transportation, and workers. Rights cannot remain signs above an entrance. They acquire practical force only when institutions carry them across the final distance.

readingPoint: ここが転換点である。家族負担の観察から、権利を生活へ届ける制度設計へ視野を広げる。理念を否定せず、理念が実効性を持つための中間装置を問う。

title: 費用は移動する
jp: 外部化という言葉は、費用が制度の外へ出たことを示すだけで、消滅を意味しない。家族が無償で担えば市場価格は付かず、支出の数字も増えない。それでも時間は使われ、移動があり、別の仕事や休息が押しのけられる。市場に現れたものだけを価値や負担として数えれば、帳簿は整っても生活の総額を誤る。必要なのは、誰が支払ったかだけでなく、誰の一日へ請求が移されたかを見ることである。
translationLiteral: The word externalization only shows that a cost has moved outside the system; it does not mean that the cost has disappeared. If a family takes it on without pay, no market price is attached and the expenditure figure does not rise. Even so, time is used, travel occurs, and other work or rest is pushed aside. If only what appears in the market is counted as value or burden, the ledger may be orderly while the total cost of life is mistaken. What is necessary is to see not only who paid, but into whose day the bill was moved.
translationNatural: Externalization does not eliminate a cost; it relocates it. When families supply care without pay, neither a market price nor a public expenditure necessarily appears. Time is still consumed, travel is still required, and other work or rest is displaced. An account that recognizes only market transactions may balance while misrepresenting the total burden on life. The final question is therefore not simply who paid money, but whose day received the bill.
imageCaption: 消えたように見える請求書が、別の人の一日の中へ差し込まれる場面。

grammar: does not A; it B は消滅と移動を対照させる。
neither A nor B は市場価格と公的支出の双方を否定する。
necessarily は否定文と組み合わさり「必ずしも〜ない」を表す。
is consumed / is required / is displaced は三つの受動態を並列する。
that recognizes ... は関係節で An account を修飾する。
may balance while misrepresenting ... は帳尻の一致と実態の誤表示が同時に起こり得ることを示す。
not simply A, but B は問いの焦点を支払者から負担先へ移す。
translationNote: 「費用は移動する」を natural の冒頭で relocates it と簡潔に定式化した。「生活の総額」は monetary total と誤解されないよう the total burden on life とし、「誰の一日へ請求が移されたか」は whose day received the bill という擬人化を保った。
readingPoint: 結末では、前章までの地域差、家族負担、権利の実装を外部化という一語へ収束させる。金銭支出だけでなく、一日の時間を受取先とする請求書を示し、静かな余韻で閉じる。
